swooper_perch_idle.method: Exact approved frame reuse in order [0,1,2,3,6,7], each150ms: slower900ms hovering beat, omitting the deepest cruise downstroke; root stationary through idle and source frame1 approaches frame0 at cruise handoff.
swooper_perch_idle.reason: ART_CONTRACT §11 permits reused frames. Idle still requires its own independent acting/timing/handoff review.

swooper_cruise.method: Separate articulated wing meshes with fixed shoulder roots, elbow flexion and phase-lagged membrane camber; unchanged torso, no global scaling. See tools/prepare-swooper-cruise.mjs and rig.json.
swooper_cruise.reason: Painted opposite-pose generation moved and changed the central hood/body instead of preserving the flight pivot (art/production-candidates/swooper-downstroke-r01). Static source key independently accepted; derived animation requires separate review.
